full_prompt_en: This is a square cinematic, photorealistic digital portrait of a dark-haired woman holding a pistol beside her face in cold blue-grey light. The background falls into near-black vertical surfaces, with only faint cool reflections interrupting the dark field on the left. Her upper body occupies the centre and right in a tight three-quarter crop. Loose damp strands fall across the forehead and beside the cheeks, breaking the outline of her short dark hair. Her expression is stern, with closed lips and eyes directed outward beneath a lowered brow. On the left, a bent arm brings a dark-gloved hand and an upright pistol close to her face; the weapon merges partly into shadow, its edges marked by a few blue glints. The forearm crosses diagonally from the lower centre toward the hand. A black sleeveless top has a low neckline, a glossy textured surface and a broad shoulder strap with a small buckle. The bare shoulder and upper arm at the right form a broad light shape against the dark clothing. Fine wet-looking highlights dot the exposed skin, while brighter reflections collect on the top and individual hair strands. A cool source from above and left creates gradual modelling across the face and shoulder, with deep shadow beneath the brow, alongside the nose and below the raised arm. Subtle photographic grain softens the image without erasing its material detail. The overall composition contrasts an illuminated face and curved shoulder with narrow dark verticals, using restrained blue-grey colour and selective shine to create a tense, enclosed atmosphere.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形电影感写实数码肖像，深发女子在冷蓝灰光中将手枪持于脸旁。背景沉入近黑的竖向表面，仅左侧少量冷色反光打断暗底。她的上身以紧密三分之二侧面裁切占据中央和右侧。潮湿散发落过额头及面颊旁，打断深色短发的外轮廓。她神情严肃，嘴唇闭合，双眼从压低的眉下朝外看。左侧，一条弯起的手臂将戴深色手套的手与直立手枪带到脸旁；枪身部分融入阴影，边缘只有几点蓝色微光。前臂从下方中央斜向持枪的手。黑色无袖上衣领口较低，表面带反光纹理，宽肩带上有小扣件。右侧裸露肩部和上臂形成宽阔亮形，对照深色衣物。细小湿润亮点散布在露出的皮肤上，较亮反光集中于上衣和个别发丝。来自左上方的冷光在脸与肩部建立渐变体积，眉下、鼻侧和抬起的手臂下方积着深影。细微摄影颗粒柔化画面，又保留材质细节。整体以受光面孔和弧形肩部对照狭窄暗色竖线，通过克制蓝灰调与局部光泽形成紧张封闭的氛围。
style_prompt_en: Cinematic photorealistic rendering uses a cold near-monochromatic palette, low-key illumination and selective reflective detail. Midnight blue, charcoal and muted slate merge across broad dark areas, while pale blue-grey highlights define the clearest planes. Fine granular texture coexists with small wet-looking glints and a few glossy reflections, creating material contrast without heavy outlines. A directional upper-side light produces gradual modelling and deeper compact shadows; softly lost edges allow surrounding shapes to merge into darkness. Tight framing and asymmetrically concentrated brightness leave a compressed, enclosed space. The overall effect is restrained and tense, balancing realistic surface detail with large quiet shadow masses.
style_prompt_zh: 电影感写实渲染采用偏冷的近单色配色、低调照明和选择性反光细节。午夜蓝、炭灰与低调石板色在大片暗部相融，浅蓝灰高光界定最清楚的受光面。细颗粒纹理与微小湿润亮点、少量光滑反射并存，不靠重描边便形成材质对比。斜上方定向光建立渐变体积和集中深影；柔和消失的边缘使周边形体融入黑暗。紧密取景与不对称集中的亮度形成压缩、封闭的空间。整体克制而紧张，在写实表面细节与大片安静暗块之间取得平衡。
theme_en: A dark-haired woman in a sleeveless black top holds a compact pistol beside her face against a blue-grey field
theme_zh: 一名穿无袖黑上衣的深发女子在蓝灰暗底前将小型手枪握在脸旁
name: Resident Evil
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
